messages:
amanda: Heads-up — PartnerCorp started bulk-replaying usage batches from last weekend. We're seeing a spike in late arrivals and a reconciliation mismatch (~34k usage units). Anyone able to triage? :eyes:
raj: saw the alert. can you paste the sample payload and the partner batch IDs?
marta: is this the nightly replay job or a separate manual retry?
amanda: appears to be manual retries triggered by PartnerCorp's ops after they rotated their signing key. They retried 2026-03-14..2026-03-16 windows.
marketplace-bot: ALERT: marketplace/ingest/pending-late-batches > 1000 for PartnerCorp (region: us-west-2)
devon: hey all — partner ops here. we rotated the key yesterday and then retried. we thought the new signer would match but some payloads were rejected then requeued. sorry about the noise.
raj: ok — that explains it. rejected vs accepted will explain the delta. do we have failure logs showing 401/signature-failure?
amanda: yes — a subset of webhooks had `signature_verification_failed` and were put back into partner-retry-queue. some of the earliest retries were processed after our daily rollup closed.
marta: that would cause the ledger to miss those batches in the first-pass aggregation. we'll need a backfill plan that: 1) identifies the idempotency key window, 2) replays into the hourly-rollup, 3) marks any late credits for manual review.
devon: we can provide the full list of partner batch IDs + retry timestamps. attaching sample payload below:
```
{
  "batch_id": "pc-20260315-4821",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "usage": [ { "meter": "tokens", "units": 12000 } ],
  "signed_at": "2026-03-15T03:12:21Z",
  "retry_index": 1,
  "signature": "<sig>"
}
```
raj: thanks. first quick checks: run `SELECT count(*) FROM ingest_log WHERE partner_batch_id = 'pc-20260315-4821'` and check `status`/`processed_at` fields. if processed_at > rollup_cutoff then it missed the initial aggregation.
amanda: i've run that for a sample: status=processed, processed_at=2026-03-16T02:05:12Z (our hour-rollup cutoff 2026-03-15T23:59:59Z).
marta: yep missed. proposed remediation: 1) id list of missed batches, 2) create a backfill job that re-injects into `hourly_rollup_reprocess` with `reprocess_reason=partner_late_retry`, 3) mark any resulting delta > threshold for finance review.
raj: operational questions: will reprocessing be idempotent? do we have dedupe by partner_batch_id in rollup?
amanda: rollup is idempotent if `partner_batch_id` exists in `rollup_state` table. but because these were never included, reprocess will apply. we need to ensure we don't double-apply in case partner re-sends again.
devon: we can freeze retries on our side for the affected windows until backfill completes. i can coordinate a partner-side hold for ~2 hours.
marta: good. also need to ensure entitlement TTL hasn't expired. some entitlements are 30-day claims; older late batches may fall outside. we should surface TTL expiries to finance before applying credits.
raj: action items: Amanda to produce CSV of missed partner_batch_ids + original timestamps (due in 30m). Dev to hold retries. Marta to draft SQL for reprocess job and a safeguards checklist. I'll own runbook and monitor metrics.
amanda: starting CSV export now. sample row format: `partner_batch_id,timestamp,units,original_status`
raj: add a `signature_verification_result` column so we can trace which were rejected initially.
amanda: done. pushing to `s3://redwood-partner-backfills/partnercorp/1715556789-missed.csv` (private link).
devon: got it. holding retries. thanks. :thumbsup:
marta: i'll prepare the reprocess statement. rough prototype below — please review before I run in staging:
```
INSERT INTO hourly_rollup_reprocess (partner_batch_id, payload, reprocess_reason, requested_by)
SELECT partner_batch_id, raw_payload, 'partner_late_retry', 'marta' FROM ingest_log
WHERE partner = 'PartnerCorp' AND processed_at > '2026-03-15T23:59:59Z' AND processed = true
AND partner_batch_id IN (SELECT partner_batch_id FROM s3_csv('s3://redwood-partner-backfills/partnercorp/1715556789-missed.csv'));
```
raj: a few checks before run: - add a max_units cap to avoid unexpected big credits - run in staging and diff ledger totals - ensure `reprocess_run_id` is recorded
amanda: agreed on cap. i've flagged any batch > 250k units for manual review (there are 2).
devon: partner has okayed the hold. we'll also send a signed confirmation once backfill runs.
marta: i'll run the job in staging in ~45m and post the staging diff.
raj: i'll be on watch. set alert on `ledger_delta` > 0.1% for the partner post-backfill.
amanda: will update the partner slack channel and finance. prepping short note for partner comms: "we're reprocessing a small set of late batches due to signature rotation retries; expected net credit < $X; we'll notify when complete."
devon: good note. thanks everyone.
amanda: thanks — closing the loop here once staging diff looks good. :white_check_mark:
